annotations.title: Get an incident with its evidence

description: Use this when the user asks whether an outage was real, how it was confirmed, when it started and ended, what else it affected, or who was told. Returns the incident with its evidence: the regions that confirmed it and how, which region failed first and when, false alarms overturned around it, checks rolled into it, its updates, and who was notified (member emails, webhook deliveries, status page subscriber notices). Also what was happening outside the site at that time, with a one-line finding: the site's dependency checks by region, and for each third-party service it relies on, what the vendor's status page reported and what FlareWarden's own checks of that service recorded. Not for listing incidents: use list_incidents.

incident.description: The incident id, from list_incidents or get_site.

site.description: The incident's site: its id, name or part of its URL.

name: get_incident
